## Highlights

- **Skills file browser:** open any skill's package as a file tree — `SKILL.md` first, then `references/` and `scripts/` — with a rendered Markdown preview or source view per file. Plugin skills expose their real files now.
- **Create memories and skills by hand:** the New memory form (title, type, description, content) writes proper frontmatter plus a `MEMORY.md` index line; deleting a memory file cleans up its index entry. New skills are created inline the same way.
- **One layout for Memory, Skills and Subagents:** the three Agent tabs share a file-tree master-detail view with full-row selection; the Subagents side sheet is gone — detail and editor open in place.
- **Calmer diff review:** per-line marks are optional, hunk headers are hidden in previews, and agent cards show short model labels.

### Fixed

- Skill packages list all files (plugin skills previously showed `SKILL.md` only).
- Deleting a memory file no longer leaves a stale line in `MEMORY.md`.

**Windows:** signed NSIS installer; the auto-update feed (`updater/latest.json`) is updated with this release.
